params.1273: Given by Sir Kay in Camelot Castle for completing all Elite Tasks in Seers' Village.
params.1292: Seers' headband 4 and a set of magic lamps worth 145,000xp in five skills of your choice.
params.1274: The headband gains the following extra benefits:
params.1275: - The Camelot Teleport spell will teleport you to the centre of Seers' Village.
params.1276: Enhanced Excalibur's special attack will heal you for twice as much.
params.1277: Up to 200 coal a day will be transferred directly to your bank if placed in the coal trucks.
params.1278: Increased chance of activating the special effect of an enchanted bolt.
params.1279: Geoffrey in the flax field near Seers' Village will give you 200 flax per day.
